name: Asahel
bio: Asahel was the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab and Abishai, swift of foot as a wild gazelle. When Joab's and Abner's forces clashed at the pool of Gibeon, Asahel chased Abner relentlessly, refusing to turn aside; Abner repeatedly warned him off, urging him to seize a younger man's weapons instead, and asked, "Why should I strike you down? How could I look your brother Joab in the face?" But Asahel would not stop, so Abner thrust the butt of his spear into his stomach, and it came out his back, killing him instantly (2 Samuel 2:18-23). His death became the direct cause of Joab's later assassination of Abner in revenge, adding a layer of personal vendetta to the conflict between the houses of David and Saul.
